timelineNodes.label: Ryuudou finale
timelineNodes.summary: Saber defeats Assassin and destroys the Grail with Excalibur.

timelineNodes.label: UBW beats Gate of Babylon
timelineNodes.summary: Shirou opens Unlimited Blade Works and counters Gate of Babylon, then Archer shoots Gilgamesh.

timelineNodes.label: Route ending variants
timelineNodes.summary: Good Ending keeps Saber present; True Ending sends Shirou and Rin to London while Saber disappears reconciled.

cause: Gilgamesh tries to complete the corrupted Grail using Shinji as the vessel.
process: Saber eliminates Assassin and destroys the Grail while Shirou's Unlimited Blade Works counters Gilgamesh until Archer finishes the battle.
outcome: Gilgamesh is defeated, Archer departs reconciled, and the route branches into Good and True endings.
relationshipChanges: Archer asks Rin to care for his past self
Shirou and Rin continue together in True Ending
